name: Throne of ages
detailed_description:
▣ Throne of Ages ▣

▣ Clash of Legacies ▣

A Chinese strategy roguelike with real-time combat, blending grand-scale RTS battles with roguelike challenges.

—Core Features—

Assemble Your Forces

Recruit officers and build your army. Each commander provides unique bonuses—some excel in cavalry charges, others in siege defense, strategic planning, or logistical support. Upgrade and enhance your troops after battles to forge a legendary division transcending history.

▣ Dynamic Battlefield Generator▣

Every match creates a procedurally generated "Rise and Fall" map: Xiang Yu might rise in Jianye, Tang Dynasty armored cavalry could besiege Youzhou, or Genghis Khan's banners might appear at Shanhaiguan. Historical turning points shape endlessly varied battle scenarios, with enemy factions fielding diverse units and legendary commanders—you'll never know which warlord awaits at the next checkpoint.

▣ Tactical Warfare System▣

Real-time Command

Lead multiple units across vast battlefields. Execute tactics like hammer-and-anvil strikes, flanking, or fire attacks. Beware the "Command Banners" system—critical orders require limited banners to issue.

Diverse Combat Mechanics

Ambush battles, surprise raids, river crossings, supply raids, and more. Terrain matters: rivers can become fiery traps, valleys transform into killing zones. Recreate desperate last stands, lightning-night assaults, or legendary victories against overwhelming odds.

—The Stage of History—

When Qin Shi Huang's sword shatters temporal chains, every dynasty's flames reignite on this chessboard of fate. Will you gather heroes like the 28 Constellations of Emperor Guangwu, or reignite the ambition of Emperor Hongwu to reshape the land?

This battle is not merely for territory—

It will decide the true legacy of Chinese civilization.
